preconditions.description: The number of objects n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(type_i in {0, 1} for type_i in types)
all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each a_i is between 0 and n inclusive.
There is at least one hotel.

postconditions.description: The path length k is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n for v_i in path)
postconditions.description: Each v_i in the path is between 1 and n inclusive.
The last object in the path is a hotel.
All objects in the path except the last one are mountains.

postconditions.expression: all(a[path[i] - 1] == path[i - 1] for i in range(1, k))
postconditions.description: For each i, there is a ski track from v_{i-1} to v_i.

postconditions.expression: k == max(len(p) for p in paths if p[-1] == types.index(1) + 1 and all(types[v_i - 1] == 0 for v_i in p[:-1]) and all(a[p[i] - 1] == p[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(p))))
postconditions.description: The path length k is maximal among all valid paths.
